latestVersion.changelog:
Storage Maximizer v1.0.0 — initial release

- Introduces five smart storage strategies (vertical, hidden, category-based, frequency layering, seasonal rotation) for maximizing space.
- Workflow guides users through a space audit, strategy selection, labeling, budget-friendly solutions, and maintenance.
- Designed to be renter-friendly and budget-conscious—most strategies require no new purchases or permanent modifications.
- Complements “home-organization-blueprint” skill by finding space for items when standard plans run out of room.
- Includes clear safety guidance and differentiates the skill’s focus from remodeling or hoarding cases.
